-- Copiar faturamentos da Mascote (tenant 1 → tenant 60002)
INSERT INTO faturamentos (empresaSlug, data, cat1, cat2, cat3, cat4, cat5, observacao, lancadoPor, createdAt, updatedAt, tenantId)
SELECT empresaSlug, data, cat1, cat2, cat3, cat4, cat5, observacao, lancadoPor, createdAt, updatedAt, 60002
FROM faturamentos
